name: Ghe hap
summary: Swimming crab, steamed, in the night-market meal Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu describes. The same report lists ghẹ among the seafood on the stalls. This is not cua mặt trăng. A price for the crab alone was not printed.
origin: Chợ đêm Côn Đảo. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, 16 May 2025.
howToEat: Choose the crab and have it steamed, or grilled if that is what you ask. The market opens at 17:00.
A crab price was not printed. The five-person dinner that included this plate was 1,200,000 đồng. That figure is the dinner. Check on arrival.
where: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in front of the daily market.
seoTitle: Ghe hap — steamed swimming crab in Con Dao
seoDescription: Ghẹ hấp is steamed swimming crab at the Côn Đảo night market. It is not cua mặt trăng. A crab price was not printed. Check on arrival.
